problem_text:
A logistics company needs to select packages for a cargo shipment. Available packages are:
* Package 1: volume 19 m³, revenue $193
* Package 2: volume 32 m³, revenue $271
* Package 3: volume 16 m³, revenue $231
* Package 4: volume 50 m³, revenue $86
* Package 5: volume 39 m³, revenue $105
* Package 6: volume 22 m³, revenue $102
* Package 7: volume 49 m³, revenue $21
* Package 8: volume 22 m³, revenue $86
* Package 9: volume 7 m³, revenue $272
* Package 10: volume 21 m³, revenue $136
* Package 11: volume 7 m³, revenue $297
* Package 12: volume 7 m³, revenue $254
* Package 13: volume 34 m³, revenue $262
* Package 14: volume 19 m³, revenue $181
* Package 15: volume 40 m³, revenue $56
* Package 16: volume 14 m³, revenue $31
* Package 17: volume 41 m³, revenue $216
* Package 18: volume 17 m³, revenue $272
* Package 19: volume 46 m³, revenue $184
* Package 20: volume 15 m³, revenue $184
* Package 21: volume 17 m³, revenue $43
* Package 22: volume 29 m³, revenue $75

The cargo plane has a maximum capacity of 394 m³. Choose the combination of packages that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this volume limit. Each package must be either fully accepted or rejected.
